## Why This Is Asked

To assess practical mastery of per-tenant feature gating, canary deployments, and automated rollback in CNF gateways, including instrumentation and testability.

## Key Concepts

- Canary deployments, per-tenant isolation, ConfigMaps-based feature flags
- Argo Rollouts or Kubernetes Rollout, Prometheus alerts
- End-to-end validation, failure simulation

## Code Example

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: gateway-feature-flags
  namespace: tenant-A
data:
  enableNewGatewayPath: "true"
```

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: tenant-A-test
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: gateway-feature-flags
  namespace: tenant-A-test
data:
  enableNewGatewayPath: "true"
```

```yaml

      - pause: { duration: 5m }
```

- How would you test rollback under synthetic load? How to ensure isolation for other tenants during the rollback?

## Why This Is Asked

- Canary rollout with per-tenant isolation

```yaml
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: Rollout
metadata:
  name: gateway-rollout
  namespace: tenant-a
spec:
  replicas: 3
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: gateway
        image: ghcr.io/org/gateway:canary

    canary:
      steps:
      - setWeight: 10
      - pause: { duration: 900s }
      - setWeight: 100
```

```yaml
kind: VirtualService

        subset: canary
      weight: 10
```

## Why This Is Asked
Tests understanding of per-tenant feature flags, sidecar traffic manipulation, and config management in Kubernetes. It also exercises practical routing logic and isolation between tenants. 

## Key Concepts
- Namespace ConfigMap per-tenant feature flags
- Sidecar-based request rewriting for canary paths
- Tenant isolation via X-TENANT-ID header
- Minimal manifests for quick end-to-end validation
- Safe defaults when feature flag is off

## Code Example
```yaml
# ConfigMap example
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: cnf.canary
  namespace: tenant-a
data:
  enabled: "true"
  target: "/v1/foo"
```
```yaml
# Sidecar snippet (pseudo)
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: cnf-sidecar
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: sidecar
        image: cnf/sidecar:latest
        env:
        - name: CANARY_ENABLED
          valueFrom:
            configMapKeyRef:
              name: cnf.canary
              key: enabled
        - name: CANARY_TARGET
          valueFrom:
            configMapKeyRef:
              name: cnf.canary
              key: target
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you test this across multiple tenants concurrently?
- What are potential race conditions with ConfigMap updates and how would you mitigate them?

## Why This Is Asked
Tests ability to architect cross-cluster, tenant-isolated config rollouts with dynamic proxy configuration.

## Key Concepts
- Envoy xDS dynamic configuration and Aggregated Discovery Service (ADS)
- Kubernetes CRD-based policy model per tenant with isolation
- Canary traffic shaping with weight and time-based rollout window
- Multi-cluster consistency and safe rollback mechanisms
- Observability hooks for validation during rollout phases

## Code Example
```yaml
# (a) Tenant Routing Policy with Canary Weight and Rollout Window
apiVersion: cnf.example/v1
kind: TenantRoutePolicy
metadata:
  name: tenant-a-api-v2
  namespace: tenant-a
spec:
  tenant: tenant-a
  targetCluster: cluster-west
  route:
    path: /api/v2
    backendRefs:
      - name: gateway-service
        port: 8080
  canary:
    weight: 0  # Start at 0%
    rolloutDuration: 30m
    stepWeight: 10  # Increment by 10% each step
    stepInterval: 5m
  rollback:
    enabled: true
    failureThreshold: 5  # Rollback if 5 consecutive errors exceed threshold
    errorRateThreshold: 0.05  # 5% error rate triggers rollback
  healthCheck:
    endpoint: /healthz
    interval: 30s
    timeout: 10s
---
# (b) Sidecar Config to Watch Policy and Push Updates
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: envoy-gateway-sidecar
  namespace: gateway-system
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: xds-controller
          image: cnf/xds-controller:latest
          args:
            - --policy-namespace=tenant-a
            - --xds-address=$(POD_IP):18000
            - --sync-interval=10s
          env:
            - name: POD_IP
              valueFrom:
                fieldRef:
                  fieldPath: status.podIP
          volumeMounts:
            - name: policy-config
              mountPath: /etc/policy
              readOnly: true
        - name: envoy
          image: envoyproxy/envoy:latest
          args:
            - --config-path /etc/envoy/envoy.yaml
            - --service-cluster gateway
          volumeMounts:
            - name: envoy-config
              mountPath: /etc/envoy
      volumes:
        - name: policy-config
          configMap:
            name: tenant-policies
        - name: envoy-config
          emptyDir: {}
---
# (c) One-Namespace Test Manifest for Canary Rollout and Rollback
apiVersion: cnf.example/v1
kind: CanaryRolloutTest
metadata:
  name: tenant-a-canary-test
  namespace: tenant-a
spec:
  policyRef:
    name: tenant-a-api-v2
  testStages:
    - stage: baseline
      duration: 5m
      expectedWeight: 0
      checks:
        - type: metrics
          metric: requests_total{path="/api/v2"}
          condition: equals 0
    - stage: canary_10pct
      duration: 10m
      expectedWeight: 10
      checks:
        - type: http
          url: http://gateway.tenanta.svc/health
          expectSuccessRate: 0.95
        - type: metrics
          metric: envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_xx{cluster="backend-v2"}
          condition: exists
    - stage: canary_50pct
      duration: 10m
      expectedWeight: 50
      checks:
        - type: http
          url: http://gateway.tenanta.svc/api/v2/users
          expectSuccessRate: 0.99
    - stage: full_rollout
      duration: 5m
      expectedWeight: 100
      checks:
        - type: http
          url: http://gateway.tenanta.svc/api/v2/**
          expectSuccessRate: 0.999
  rollbackTest:
    enabled: true
    triggerFailureAt: canary_50pct
    expectedBehavior: weight_reverts_to_0_within_2m
```
